description: This source file defines the LogFragment class, an Android Fragment that hosts a LogView inside a ScrollView to display logs and responds to text changes to keep the view scrolled to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays logs in a scrollable, monospace text view, updating view position on log change.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, sets padding, appearance, and layout parameters.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view for the fragment, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance hosted by the fragment.
